description: AI toolbox for centrally managing the configuration of AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, and Grok CLI, including providers, prompts, MCP servers, skills, sessions, and a local proxy gateway. Built with Tauri; data is stored locally in SQLite.

script: # Tauri NSIS installer (currentUser). /S = silent, /D = install dir.
# /D must be the LAST switch and unquoted (NSIS requirement).
# Scoop only auto-removes the installer for installer.file/args, not for script hooks.
